turns.question: Over the six weeks from Monday 17 August to Sunday 27 September 2026, which day of the week brought in the most revenue, and how much?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no day-of-week grain, so I cannot name the weekday that brought in the most revenue from its figures without adding up daily values myself; the closest metric is Revenue (EUR), which I can give by day for 17 August to 27 September 2026 (42 days).
